Actor Larry Poindexter Dies at 66 After Being Hit by Car

Actor Larry Poindexter, known for his roles in 'Days of Our Lives,' 'JAG,' and 'S.W.A.T.,' has died at the age of 66. His death occurred after he was struck by a car.
